meta.title: Messages from us
meta.description: Choose whether Friends of Animals emails you news and updates, and see what you agreed to and when.

consent.title: Messages from us
consent.lead: Choose whether we email you news and updates. Emails about your account, like sign-in codes and receipts, come either way.

status.withdrawn: You don't get news and updates

consent.newerVersion: We've changed the text since you agreed. Read version {version} below and agree to it to keep getting news and updates.
consent.noDocument: We don't send news and updates yet. When we do, you can choose here.
consent.give: Yes, email me news and updates

notice.given: Done. We'll email you news and updates.
notice.withdrawn: Done. We won't email you news and updates any more.
notice.outdated: We changed the text while you were reading. Read the new version below, then choose again.
notice.failed: We couldn't save your choice, so nothing changed. Please try again.

auction.title: Auction consent
auction.lead: Withdraw your consent for a competition to stop any unsold auction lots of your original artwork.
